newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end at 41-month low, foreign sales.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end at 41-month low, foreign sales.

text.p: Thai stocks closed at a 41-month-low on Wednesday as mainly foreign investors sold stocks on a belief that the market was unlikely to improve anytime soon, brokers said.
Investors sold because they did not believe that new Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan would be able to quickly turn around the tide for Thailand's slowing economy, they added.
The SET Index fell 13.41 points, or 1.55 percent, to close at 853.82 points. The SET-50 closed at 64.44 down 1.29 points, or 1.96 percent in trade worth 3.784 billion baht.
The index last closed below this level on June 11, 1993.
